command:
set -e; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/scripts/final-mobile-hygiene-fix-v1.py > /tmp/final-mobile-hygiene-fix-v1.py; python3 /tmp/final-mobile-hygiene-fix-v1.py; pnpm exec prettier --write apps/mobile/src/screens/hardware-setup/pages/ShellySetupPage.tsx apps/mobile/src/screens/hardware-setup/pages/SensorSetupPage.tsx apps/mobile/src/screens/hardware-setup/pages/RuleSetupPage.tsx apps/mobile/src/theme/theme.css scripts/quality/ux-gate.mjs; git diff --check; echo '=== RAW_SVG ==='; RAW_SVG=$(git grep -n '<svg' -- apps/mobile/src | grep -E '\.tsx:' | grep -v '/__tests__/' || true); printf '%s
' "$RAW_SVG"; test -z "$RAW_SVG"; echo GATE_RAW_SVG_OK; echo '=== INLINE_STYLE ==='; INLINE=$(git grep -n 'style={{' -- apps/mobile/src | grep -E '\.tsx:' | grep -v '/__tests__/' || true); printf '%s
' "$INLINE"; test -z "$INLINE"; echo GATE_INLINE_STYLE_OK; echo '=== LEGACY_GEAR ==='; GEAR=$(git grep -n 'SettingsGearIcon' -- apps/mobile/src || true); printf '%s
' "$GEAR"; test -z "$GEAR"; echo GATE_LEGACY_GEAR_OK; pnpm quality:ux; echo QUALITY_UX_OK; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile lint; echo LINT_OK; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile typecheck; echo TYPECHECK_OK; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile test -- hardware-setup; echo TEST_OK; git reset --hard HEAD; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo HYGIENE_DIAG_OK
